definitions.explanation: A book that gathers several short stories, usually by a single author. May also refer to a collection of short films or other brief works.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought this author's short story collection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧1{話|わ}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read one story from a short story collection each night before bed.

examples.japanese: ⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長編|ちょうへん}→長編：14475_chouhen⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}だった。
examples.english: Their debut work was not a novel but a short story collection.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧ (short piece) + {集|しゅう} (collection). Each story in such a volume is called a ⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧ or ⟦{短編|たんぺん}{小説|しょうせつ}→短編小説：20776_tanpenshousetsu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短編集|たんぺんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a short story collection
- {短編集|たんぺんしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to publish a short story collection
- ⟦ミステリー→ミステリー：22731_misuterii⟧{短編集|たんぺんしゅう}: mystery short story collection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長編|ちょうへん}{小説|しょうせつ}→長編小説：20799_chouhenshousetsu⟧: novel; long-form work — antonym
- ⟦{中編|ちゅうへん}→中編：19271_chuuhen⟧: novella — between short story and novel in length
- アンソロジー: anthology — loanword, often used for multi-author collections
- {作品集|さくひんしゅう}: works collection — broader, can include any genre or medium
